reason: Make the child outcome require exact joint-consensus quorum and interoperable AuthorityCertificateV1 verification.

operation.value: Implement OpenRaft committed authority whose certificates satisfy a stable majority or both constituent majorities during joint membership, reject insufficient union majorities, and use the exact Ed25519, domain-separated SHA-256, deterministic prost, activation-possession, lease, and mutation-sink contract frozen by #5821.
